correctness.rationale: CRT gives Hq≅C5×C(q−1) and index8. Directly tabulating the eight cosets Cj=6^jK modulo41 yields sums (82,82,123,123,123,123,82,82). For X_i=C_i×Fq×, the exact ordinary-integer lift calculation gives S41q(X_i)−41q|X_i|/2=q(s_i−s_(i−j)). Consequently the own-subgroup defect, all-coset translational-period criterion and witness mod123 follow without approximation. Coprime progression count modulo205 has 160 classes, of which 60 cyclic+centered, 45 cyclic+centered but not all-coset, 15 cyclic+all-coset; PNT in progressions proves stated densities. For p<41, cyclic index-eight full-factor kernel forces p≡9 mod16, impossible for prime p=9 or25, while p=41 works. Independent octic arithmetic recomputed all 8 local sums and CRT defects for sample odd primes; the symbolic proof, not finite sampling, gives all primes. Initial RESULT.md falsely separated two equivalent ALL-COSET notions; the fully staged replacement correctly identifies their known equivalence, retaining the valid distinction from own-subgroup centeredness.
